```{r, echo=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(extrafont)
library(cowplot)
library(car)
library(lme4)
library(effectsize)
```
```{r}
# function to define the B3 lab theme
theme_B3 <- function () { 
  theme_classic() +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major  = element_blank(),  # remove major gridlines
      panel.grid.minor  = element_blank(),  # remove minor gridlines
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"), # center & bold
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold") # center & bold 
    )
}
```
```{r figure out working directory}
getwd()
```

#1.Get general data together:
```{r}
data_dry <- read.csv("/Users/AprilBooth/Desktop/Dissertation/Chapter2_cropmilk/R_markdowns/chick_cropmilkDM.csv")
data_dry$nestid <- data_dry$nest_id
data_dry <- select(data_dry, "nestid", "chick", "avg_dry_matter","stddev", "cv_rep")
```

#2.import key with relevant treatment groups
  #key MUST have the following columns: sample, treatment 
```{r}
key <- read.csv("/Users/AprilBooth/Desktop/Dissertation/keys/chick_key.csv")
```

#3. merge key and raw data and create nest type category, also change names a little + determine CV% replicate average
```{r}
data_dry <- left_join(data_dry, key, by = "nestid")
data_dry$type[data_dry$treatment == "paired parents"] <- "paired parents"
data_dry$type[data_dry$treatment == "single male"] <- "single parent"
data_dry$type[data_dry$treatment == "single female"] <- "single parent"
data_dry$treatment[data_dry$treatment == "paired parents"] <- "paired parents"
data_dry$treatment[data_dry$treatment == "single male"] <- "single father"
data_dry$treatment[data_dry$treatment == "single female"] <- "single mother"
data_dry <- select(data_dry, -"treatment_day", -"crop.milk.data.")
```

```{r determine mean}
cv_mean <- data_dry %>% 
  summarise(mean = mean(cv_rep, na.rm = TRUE))
cv_mean
```   
```{r determine standard deviation}
cv_stdv <- data_dry %>% 
  summarise(stdv = sd(cv_rep, na.rm = TRUE))
cv_stdv
```

#4. calculate % dry matter and obtain average from two chick nests
```{r}
data_dry$percent <- data_dry$avg_dry_matter*100
```
```{r get average for two chick nests}
one <- data_dry[data_dry$brood == "one",]
two <- data_dry[data_dry$brood == "two",]
twoa <- two[two$chick == "a",]
twob <- two[two$chick == "b",]
two <- full_join(twoa, twob, by = "nestid")
two$percent <- (two$percent.x + two$percent.y)/2
two$brood <- two$brood.x
two$treatment <- two$treatment.x
two$type <- two$type.x
two <- select(two, "nestid", "brood", "percent", "treatment", "type")
```
```{r one and two data sets}
data_dry <- full_join(one, two)
data_dry <- select(data_dry,  "nestid", "brood", "percent", "treatment", "type")
```
# counting two-chick and one-chick broods
```{r}
twoa %>% count(treatment)
```
```{r}
one %>% count(treatment)
```
#5. visualize data and analyze
```{r,echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
dryw <- ggplot(aes(y = percent, x = treatment, fill = treatment), data = data_dry) + geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) + scale_fill_manual(values = colors_chick) + scale_x_discrete(limits=c("paired parents", "single mother", "single father")) + labs(title = "Percent crop milk dry matter ingested by chicks",subtitle = "by treatment group", x="", y="% Dry Matter") + geom_point(pch = 21, position = position_jitterdodge()) + theme_B3() + theme(text=element_text(family="Arial", size=12)) +theme(axis.text = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black",family="Arial", size = 12)) + theme(legend.position = "none") + ggsignif::geom_signif(comparisons = list(c("single father", "paired parents")), map_signif_level = TRUE, textsize = 9) + ylim(0,35) + theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 12))
dryw
```

```{r}
leveneTest(percent ~ treatment, data = data_dry, center="mean")
```
```{r}
leveneTest(percent ~ brood, data = data_dry, center="mean")
```
# so rank-transform better
```{r}
fit_cd <- aov(rank(percent) ~ treatment+brood , data = data_dry)
Anova(fit_cd, type = "II")
```

```{r}
eta_squared(Anova(fit_cd, type = "II"))
```

```{r}
TukeyHSD(fit_cd)
```
# so siginificant difference between single fathered and paired parented chicks
# obtain effect size
```{r}
paired <- data_dry[data_dry$treatment == "paired parents",]
smom <- data_dry[data_dry$treatment == "single mother",]
sfath <- data_dry[data_dry$treatment == "single father",]
```

```{r}
paired_v_sfath <- full_join(paired, sfath)
cohens_d(percent ~ treatment, data = paired_v_sfath)
```

#How about by nest type? 
```{r}
leveneTest(percent ~ type, data = data_dry, center="mean")
```
# so rank-transform better

```{r}
fit_cds <- aov(rank(percent) ~ type+brood , data = data_dry)
Anova(fit_cds, type = "II")
```

```{r}
eta_squared(Anova(fit_cds, type = "II"))
```

```{r,echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
dryw_p <- ggplot(aes(y = percent, x = type, fill = type), data = data_dry) + geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) + scale_fill_manual(values = colors_chick_pool) + scale_x_discrete(limits=c("paired parents", "single parent")) + labs(title ="Percent crop milk dry matter ingested by chicks",subtitle = "by nest-type", x="", y="% Dry Matter") + geom_point(pch = 21, position = position_jitterdodge()) + theme_B3() + theme(text=element_text(family="Arial", size=12)) +theme(axis.text = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black",family="Arial", size = 12)) + theme(legend.position = "none") + ggsignif::geom_signif(comparisons = list(c("single parent", "paired parents")), map_signif_level = TRUE, textsize = 9) + ylim(0,35) +  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 12))
dryw_p
```

# so when single parented chicks pooled together, there is a significant difference in dry matter-- with single parented chicks receiving less dry matter than paired parented chicks. 

### asynchronous nests
## first hatched chicks
```{r,echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
asynch_a <- ggplot(aes(y = percent, x = treatment, fill = treatment), data = twoa) + geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) + scale_fill_manual(values = colors_chick) + scale_x_discrete(limits=c("paired parents", "single mother", "single father")) + labs(title = "", x="", y="% Dry Matter") + geom_point(pch = 21, position = position_jitterdodge()) + theme_B3() + theme(text=element_text(family="Arial", size=14)) +theme(axis.text = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black",family="Arial", size = 12)) + theme(legend.position = "none") #+ ggsignif::geom_signif(comparisons = list(c("single father", "paired parents")), map_signif_level = TRUE, textsize = 9) + ylim(0,35)
asynch_a
```

```{r}
leveneTest(percent ~ treatment, data = twoa, center="mean")
```
# so rank-transform better
```{r}
fit_a <- aov(rank(percent) ~ treatment, data = twoa)
Anova(fit_a)
```

```{r}
eta_squared(fit_a)
```
# nest-type
```{r}
leveneTest(percent ~ type, data = twoa, center="mean")
```
# so rank-tranform better
```{r}
t.test(percent ~ type, data = twoa, var.equal = FALSE)
```

```{r}
cohens_d(percent ~ type, data = twoa)
```
